body:
Reevaluation currently loads every immutable record and current update, constructs a complete training snapshot, sorts all IDs and builds a global node dictionary before evaluating a bounded window. This draft adds a shared disk-backed generation view and uses it only for explicitly opted-in sharded Reevaluation. Dataset remains unchanged.

- Incremental JSON array parsing, bounded transactions and a 2 MiB SQLite page cache; no full snapshot or all-node Python container on the indexed path. Reuses existing deserialization, merge, training-state codec and inference/value semantics.
- Exact lexicographic inclusive cursor/wrap/pass-count behavior. New `evaluate_node_window(nodes)` opt-in protocol; existing injected evaluators retain complete-snapshot behavior with observable fallback. Flat formats retain the legacy reader.
- SHA-256 source/schema identities on every open, atomic completed-cache publication, corruption/interruption recovery, export-order iteration for a future Dataset PR, resource observations and an ephemeral `--reevaluation-streaming-sharded-reader` flag (default off).
- Generated-only fresh-process benchmark tooling and raw 1k/5k/10k results. At K=100, legacy peak RSS grows from 283 to 369 MiB; indexed runs stay near 272–273 MiB. At 10k: cold initialization ~2.25 s, reused initialization ~0.054 s, index ~45.5 MiB. Cold builds cost CPU/disk and four logical source passes; reuse still hashes sources and validates SQLite. These are synthetic constant-model adapter measurements, not real-model throughput claims.

Validation: [hosted CI is green](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39413906723) at `79693ce2`: quality, installed-package pytest (1444 passed, two skipped), static analysis and the final gate all passed. Local validation includes 84 focused tests, six existing Reevaluation dispatcher tests, 24 remaining tail tests, repository-wide Ruff, toolchain consistency, wheel/sdist build and the serial static-analysis ratchet (zero new diagnostic identities). The serial full-suite local attempt was interrupted at an unrelated chess training multiprocessing stall; its 19 remaining environmental failures reproduce on an untouched protected-main archive (14 sandbox-blocked global-leaderboard writes and five multiprocessing/child-process failures). Details and API/allocation audit: `docs/morpion_streaming_reevaluation.md`.

High-priority durability follow-up: patch publication still exclusively opens the final JSON path and writes into it, then saves the cursor separately. Partial visibility and crash/replay ambiguity remain; this is not transactional or exactly-once publication. Review durability before real asynchronous deployment.

Based directly on protected main `50fb67a42577e195bc565f4d03e38d919640d08a`. Dirty research working files, Anemone investigation, Chipiron #74 and Anemone #77 untouched. Released installed Anemone 0.2.26 used (288 RECORD hashes verified). No real gen38 operation, historical scientific artifact mutation, warm Growth activation, distributed worker, dependency release or merge.

Dataset currently writes JSONL incrementally while retaining a complete training snapshot and global family maps. This draft adds an opt-in bounded extraction path using PR #75's existing `ShardedTrainingGenerationView`, with disk-backed TEMP family context on the same read-only-index connection, bounded record/frontier scans, and the original policy arithmetic and row assembly.

Stacked on #75, targeting `perf/morpion-streaming-reevaluation`, with exact parent `79693ce2dc59c6d6ccb951951c9ba75fa69057f3`. Independent worktree/branch; PR #75 and the dirty research checkout are unchanged.

- Exact parity for all nine target policies at 1k/5k/10k nodes, including rows, canonical refs, values/sources/flags, families/blends, filters/max_rows, metadata/counters and JSONL bytes. An unmodified archive of the exact PR #75 source independently matches all four complete scientific artifacts (rows, generation manifest, Dataset status and leaderboard) for every policy and size.
- Generated-only fresh-process RSS/throughput measurements, short families and one whole-generation PV family, plus the escaped-surrogate parser case. At 10k, standard-fixture legacy/cold/reuse peak RSS is 489.14/273.79/273.70 MiB; cold/reused worker time is 5.967/3.759 s (~2,185 reused emitted rows/s). Reader initialization drops from 2.395 s cold to 0.0538 s reused; the existing index is 45.94 MiB and TEMP context is about 1.81 MiB logical disk.
- Default remains off. Ephemeral `--dataset-streaming-sharded-reader` flag supports Dataset and Dataset worker. Flat/both/non-JSONL and unsupported family cases retain legacy. Malformed sources fail; source identity is checked before complete output publication. No additional source parser or reader index.
- Failure/recovery tests cover generation changes, changed source identity, malformed sources, interrupted/stale output, cache reuse, cycles, deterministic passes and claim cleanup. Existing PR #75 cache/corruption/parser tests remain in the regression set.

Validation: 224 local focused/regression tests passed, 11 additional float-order/empty/launcher checks passed, 22 installed-wheel focused tests and installed evaluator/checkpoint contracts passed; wheel/sdist, repository-wide Ruff, toolchain coherence and serial static ratchet passed (zero new diagnostic identities). [Full hosted CI is green](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39419644086) at `5c8906ba0d520c63d821e14a2d52530f8bed2307`: **1578 passed, 2 skipped**, with quality, installed-package pytest, static analysis and the final aggregate gate all successful. Two broader local tests encounter the existing sandbox restriction on the real global leaderboard; it was not given write access.

[Parity report, allocation audit, raw RSS/throughput/index observations, remaining limits and activation plan](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/blob/perf/morpion-streaming-dataset/docs/morpion_streaming_dataset.md). Disk and CPU/I/O costs remain: multi-pass reconstruction, full-file hashing, TEMP context rebuild, per-generation cache duplication and cache retention. Rows/manifest/leaderboard publication is not transactional or exactly-once; downstream training and single-process cycle memory remain separate work. Keep opt-in disabled pending review and an explicitly authorized immutable-copy canary.

No historical experiment, real gen38 operation, four-worker activation, scientific-policy change, dependency release or automatic merge.

body:
Sharded node records already own a normalized, detached state-reference payload. Serializing each new record copied that payload a second time, retaining another nested JSON object graph while encoding the immutable shard. This reuses the owned payload and keeps the initial normalization/ownership boundary intact.

The production change replaces three lines. It changes no fields, formats, generation/index behavior, runtime policy or dependency pins. A new semantic regression covers a dumper that reuses and later mutates a nested mapping: each node must retain its own snapshot.

On a bounded 5k fixture, first-export traced Python peak allocation falls from **15,161,168 to 13,563,821 bytes** (10.5%, about 1.52 MiB). Reverse-order baseline measurement reproduces the reduction. Repeated generations change little because only 39/26 refs are new. Normal wall-time results are mixed; this is an allocation optimization, without a consistent throughput-speedup claim.

Validation:

- All remote quality, static, pytest and aggregate gates pass on exact head `67a7cfd1955f43d5947af01dbb324fb5efd93a0d`: [CI evidence](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39423007354), including **1,390 passed tests / 2 skipped**.
- 32 fresh-process 1k/5k trials, 96 export stages: every retained export JSON structure and raw byte matches within each format across cold/warm and before/after. Selections, checkpoint components and complete retained generation-3/4 checkpoint contents also match.
- Eight writer tests, 172 relevant local writer/runtime/pipeline/performance tests, sdist/wheel build and installed-package contracts pass. The relevant pipeline suite uses temporary default leaderboard paths; record logic and assertions still run. The report separately records the interrupted broad local run and its sandbox/default-home-path limitations.
- Repository Ruff and toolchain checks pass. The static ratchet reports zero new diagnostics; the reviewed baseline is unchanged. All retained research drivers are smoke-tested against exact output.

The original reported ~20% warm penalty is not reproduced: 1k flat export totals are 10.862s cold / 10.867s warm; 5k totals are 81.111s / 79.508s. The retained old benchmark actually used flat export. A separate unchanged-baseline audit finds flat/sharded state-ref ordering, target/provenance and incoming-DAG-parent differences. This patch preserves existing shard contents and does not establish cross-format equivalence or production readiness.

See [the full report, exact source identities and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/blob/67a7cfd1955f43d5947af01dbb324fb5efd93a0d/docs/research/morpion_training_export_performance_2026-10-20.md), with phase timing, CPU/RSS, decode counts, allocation snapshots and JSON evidence.

Independent against protected main `50fb67a42577e195bc565f4d03e38d919640d08a`; implementation commit `d7590c0f204ff5ff39339d9e62a2a20557bc7cd1`. Chipiron PR74 and Anemone PR77/PR78 are unchanged. Warm lifecycle experiments use a separately pinned temporary combination. **Production warm reuse remains disabled.** No real gen38 continuation, historical-workspace mutation, distributed worker or merge.

body:
Reevaluation previously exclusively opened the final patch path and wrote JSON into it, allowing concurrent Growth readers to see an incomplete patch. This publishes validated, fsynced bytes from a unique same-directory temporary file using `os.link`, preserving create-only producer semantics and the exact existing patch/cursor payloads.

Stacked on PR #75, targeting `perf/morpion-streaming-reevaluation`, based exactly on `79693ce2dc59c6d6ccb951951c9ba75fa69057f3`. This is the narrowly scoped publication part of the 2026-10-20 operator durability audit; broader JSON writers and checkpoint-bound acknowledgement remain separate.

- `publish_reevaluation_patch_if_absent(patch, path) -> bool`: file validation/fsync, atomic no-replace hard link, parent-directory fsync, owned-temporary cleanup and another directory fsync. Existing entries win without modification. No replacement/direct-write fallback.
- Post-link I/O/cleanup failures retain the final entry and raise `ReevaluationPatchPublicationError` with the original errno/cause and observed inode state. The worker does not advance its cursor on an error; restart inspects the actual pending path using existing guards.
- Supported durability assumptions, full before/after crash matrix, API and remaining risks: [publication documentation](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/blob/b0980ab41cb1ebf178d4ef26d49e82dd5d57ca76/docs/morpion_reevaluation_patch_publication.md). Local Linux/POSIX hard links and directory fsync are required; temporary/final mode is 0600.

Validation: 146 focused tests passed, including deterministic two-producer contention, a concurrent reader paused across partial temporary writes/link publication, subprocess crashes before/after linking and during cleanup, orphan handling, injected write/fsync/link/cleanup failures, and exact patch/cursor byte parity against the former writer through both legacy and PR #75 indexed paths. Repository-wide Ruff formatting/lint and toolchain checks passed; targeted strict mypy, Pyright and Pylint passed. One unrelated single-process artifact test was deselected after its existing global-leaderboard write hit the sandbox read-only boundary; no historical artifact was changed. [Hosted normal CI is green](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39431399798) at `b0980ab4`: quality, installed-package pytest (**1474 passed, 2 skipped**), static analysis (**zero new diagnostic identities**) and the final gate all passed.

This does **not** make patch/cursor/checkpoint operations transactional or exactly once. Growth still deletes patches before checkpoint commitment, and replay/blending/cursor races remain. The next durability PR should retain patches through a checkpoint-bound identity receipt and perform identity-checked durable acknowledgement with the audit's ownership/commit prerequisites.

Only this isolated worktree and new branch were changed. No real gen38 operation, historical artifact mutation, distributed worker, Growth/training experiment, Anemone modification or merge.

body:
Ordinary Growth eagerly deletes a Reevaluation patch before its effects are checkpointed. This adds an **opt-in** checkpoint-bound receipt path: retain the patch, sync a private checkpoint and required artifacts, then commit the checkpoint identity and cumulative ID/content-hash receipts together in one atomic durable `run_state.json` replacement. A matching committed receipt skips reapplication, including non-idempotent blending; exact acknowledgement follows durable producer-cursor observation.

Stacked on draft #78, targeting `fix/morpion-durable-reevaluation-publication`, based exactly on `b0980ab41cb1ebf178d4ef26d49e82dd5d57ca76`. The PR #78 producer and PR #75 streaming Reevaluation implementation are unchanged.

- API: `run_pipeline_growth_stage(..., checkpoint_bound_receipts=True)`; defaults off, with no CLI/launcher/orchestrator activation. Existing quiescent baseline required; legacy pending patches, missing/corrupt state and unsupported restore modes fail closed.
- A stable kernel Growth lease spans cold restore through acknowledgement. Checkpoints and flat exports use unique private attempts; the authoritative state is committed before the discovery manifest. No second independent commit journal.
- New patches force a checkpoint attempt even with zero Growth or unmet save thresholds. RAM/diagnostic refusal retains the patch and old committed head, with no receipt for volatile effects. This changes publication cadence and is explicitly experimental.
- Receipts bind ID, exact patch SHA-256, source tree/evaluator generation, evaluator/bundle identity and SHA-256, resulting checkpoint path/hash/generation, requested/applied row counts and effective alpha. Descendant heads retain all receipts.
- **Production activation stops here:** additive sharded export/index retry, general writer ownership and retention need the audit's independent publication PR. This path permits flat or skipped training export only and disables Growth pruning. Producer death before cursor publication safely waits pending; automatic producer-cursor repair remains separate.

[Protocol, API, receipt format, ownership assumptions, A–O before/after crash matrix, cold restart, rollout/rollback and remaining limitations](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/blob/7313ecfad36667ab2a8dd1bbd4b894aa682a7e9b/docs/morpion_checkpoint_bound_patch_receipts.md).

Local validation: **54 new synthetic tests** passed in one focused run, including subprocess exits around every transaction phase, each traced fsync failure, namespace exceptions before/after replace and unlink, exact alpha-0.5 effects and counts, zero Growth/RAM refusal, identity conflicts, cursor barriers and independent producer/consumer hand-offs, including a producer paused immediately after hard-link visibility and before its durability confirmation. Growth syncs that observed publication before applying it. **181 existing focused regressions + 8 real adapter blend/terminal-row tests** passed. Repository Ruff and targeted strict mypy/Pyright/Pylint passed. Two existing Dataset tests hit the sandbox's global-leaderboard write restriction; no write succeeded, and Dataset cases were excluded from the local rerun. [Normal hosted CI passed](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39448176157) on final head `7313ecfad36667ab2a8dd1bbd4b894aa682a7e9b`: installed-package contracts and pytest (**1528 passed, 2 skipped**), quality, static (**zero new mypy/Pyright/Pylint diagnostic identities**) and the final gate are all green.

No historical/derived workspace mutation, gen38 operation, distributed worker, Growth/training experiment, changes to other task branches or merge. No end-to-end exactly-once claim for the four-worker pipeline.

body:
Sharded v1 discards actual effective values/provenance and explicit null tree targets, and freezes incoming parents even though DAG nodes gain parents later. This adds a separate scientific v2 writer and full reference reader. Every generation stores current topology/depth, independent D/T/E/target scalars, actual candidate provenance, target declarations and complete per-value certainty/Value payloads. New nodes receive exact flat-compatible canonical references; old references are reused.

**Stacked draft on PR #77**, exact base `67a7cfd1955f43d5947af01dbb324fb5efd93a0d`, targeting `perf/morpion-training-export`. V1 source/interpretation and artifacts are unchanged. No Dataset/Reevaluation routing or production activation; bounded-reader v2 support belongs in a later PR reusing #75/#76. No upstream Anemone branches changed.

Validation:

- 77 local writer/scientific-contract/checkpoint tests pass. Tests retain the v1 failures, including partial D=9/T=3, late DAG parents, direct fallback targets and noncanonical replay order.
- 648 small-fixture row comparisons cover all nine policies, both backup preferences, prediction blends, filters and truncation: every field/summary and complete JSONL byte matches the authoritative saved flat snapshot.
- Generated nominal 1k/5k actual search graphs (1,003/5,013 nodes), three generations: every scientific snapshot field and full live Value payload matches. Another 54 all-policy JSONL pairs match; 48 export files repeat byte-for-byte across fresh ordered/reverse trials. A final replay using the committed validation script reproduces all retained evidence exactly; source fingerprints match the committed implementation.
- Real legal terminal boards, both Morpion variants, score/certainty tie directions, saved/reloaded checkpoints, malformed/mixed versions, missing/null fields, source hashes, noncanonical refs and interrupted publication are covered.
- Repository Ruff/format gates pass; strict static ratchet has **zero new diagnostics**. Full hosted CI passes on exact head `bfd8f2ab05f017ffda5e14af5dbf6e1f1afa3fde`: **1,451 passed / 2 skipped**, all quality/static/pytest/aggregate gates green: [CI run](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39447924678).

Measured fresh-process 5k v2: initial **19.115–20.296s**, repeated identical generation **0.417–0.419s**, growth generation **0.407–0.422s**, peak process RSS **344.34–344.41 MiB**. Initial canonicalization reconstructs 5,013 checkpoint states; repeated generation performs zero state requests/decodes/canonical dumps. Three-generation v2 bytes: **14,506,212**. The initial canonicalization cost is substantial versus lossy v1; this does not claim a controlled speedup or bounded-total-memory writer. Raw counters, source fingerprints and shared-host timing limitations are recorded.

**Activation blockers:** extend the existing bounded reader with strict v2 decoding/cache identity/source checks, and resolve the demonstrated node-exact/estimated-tree confidence association before production Dataset anchors. V2 preserves and exposes that distinction; it does not silently change the nine policies. The writer retains O(N+E) IDs/topology and input resolver caches; the reference reader is intentionally O(N).

See `docs/research/morpion_sharded_training_v2.md` for the precise schema, invariants, compatibility table, failure evidence, measurements, reproduction commands, downstream implications and separately reviewable bounded-reader integration plan. Raw evidence: `docs/research/benchmarks/morpion_sharded_training_v2_20261020.json`.

No historical mutation/migration, gen38 operation, bootstrap/distributed worker, production activation or merge.

body:
PR #79 refuses ordinary sharded exports because an interrupted additive catalog/index update can omit creation records on retry and leave receipt checkpoints dependent on incomplete exports. This adds an explicit opt-in immutable publication namespace around the unchanged scientific v1 writer.

Stacked on draft #79, targeting `fix/morpion-checkpoint-bound-patch-receipts`, based exactly on `7313ecfad36667ab2a8dd1bbd4b894aa682a7e9b`. Other task branches and historical workspaces are unchanged.

- API: `run_pipeline_growth_stage(..., checkpoint_bound_receipts=True, durable_generation_publication=True)`. Both default off; no CLI/launcher/worker activation.
- Freeze a unique private checkpoint/export/model/config capsule, rebuild its private v1 index only from committed creation records, validate its complete history and inventory, fsync files/directories, then publish with Linux `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)`. No replace fallback; retries cannot overwrite a committed capsule.
- The single authoritative commit remains durable `run_state.json` replacement, binding checkpoint identity, cumulative PR #79 receipts and append-only capsule roots. Discovery follows commit. Recovery inspects actual state after uncertain rename/replace/unlink failures.
- Independent readers validate committed inventory and hold stable lifetime pins. The existing Growth lease excludes competing writers/collectors. Exact frozen model bytes retain original logical provenance. All committed capsules and legacy receipt dependencies are retained; only proven owned uncommitted attempts can be quarantined and removed.
- Scientific sharded v1 payloads, source generations, row order, checkpoint basenames/codecs and patch/cursor semantics remain unchanged. Scientific v2 is explicitly rejected; no partial integration.

[Commit protocol, complete file inventory, crash/recovery matrix, ownership, conservative retention, migration/rollback and activation blockers](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/blob/8c883a95bdc308195384e9202c1f56ab9ebe2b48/docs/morpion_durable_generation_publication.md).

Validation: **61 new generated-fixture cases**, including 19 subprocess crash boundaries, 10 fsync failures, a second crash during manifest recovery, concurrent readers and competing writers, exact checkpoint/scientific byte parity, source provenance, orphan-index retry, model pins and alpha-0.5 receipt deduplication. A focused run passed **242 tests** (16 Dataset-related cases deselected locally to avoid their configured global leaderboard path), followed by **7 passing tests** for the added double-crash case and ownership-wrapper/concurrency verification. Repository Ruff/toolchain checks and targeted strict mypy/Pyright/Pylint pass. [Normal hosted CI passed](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/actions/runs/39470535676) on head `8c883a95bdc308195384e9202c1f56ab9ebe2b48`: installed evaluator-v1/checkpoint contracts and pytest (**1589 passed, 2 skipped**), quality, static (**zero new mypy/Pyright/Pylint diagnostic identities**) and final gate all green.

[Generated-fixture measurements](https://github.com/victorgabillon/chipiron/blob/8c883a95bdc308195384e9202c1f56ab9ebe2b48/docs/morpion_generation_publication_costs.json): 1k/10k nodes, baseline plus three saves, exact final checkpoint/export hashes match legacy. Application write ratios **1.122× / 1.056×**; peak RSS **279.09 / 304.13 MiB** versus **277.01 / 299.72 MiB**; allocated unique-inode disk **3.03 / 26.15 MB** versus **1.99 / 18.84 MB**. These use synthetic scalar checkpoints/tiny model bytes, include import RSS, and do not estimate real production/model/checkpoint costs or physical device write amplification. Historical payloads share hard links; complete prefixes/inventories have O(G²) name/metadata growth. No bounded committed-generation retirement is implemented.

**Production remains disabled.** Activation still requires operator reconciliation, filesystem/capacity qualification, general writer fencing, producer cursor recovery, downstream Dataset/Training/model-pointer durability and a bounded retirement protocol. Single-process/old/manual writers must remain quiescent. No real Growth, gen38 restoration, workers, training experiment, historical artifact mutation or merge. No end-to-end exactly-once claim for the four-worker pipeline.

A proven tree value currently causes the built-in Morpion reevaluator to certify an unrelated neural prediction. On a legal two-node endgame, direct ESTIMATE(34.01), tree/effective FORCED(35), and neural prediction 42 become direct FORCED(42). Fully opened effective value remains 35; the defect is reproduced at the direct Value and checkpoint levels.

Keep built-in nonterminal predictions estimated, preserve existing terminal scores (including direct-only terminal leaves), and skip unproved model updates that would replace existing direct proofs or demote explicitly exact partial-tree backups, using each Value's own certainty. Both blending paths retain their existing rules. Explicit external certified updates, Anemone's FORCED definition and NodeValueUpdate API remain unchanged.

Dataset v1 is intentionally unchanged. The report proves a separate reachable confidence mismatch with direct-target preference: all four exact-family policies can propagate estimated 42 into a terminal training row whose certified score is 35. It documents all nine policies, synthetic versus normal reachability, the legacy snapshot-value fallback ambiguity, and versioned alternatives using scientific v2 per-value certainty.

- Ten failing-before regressions on untouched main; corrected installed-wheel focused suite: 93 passed, 3 streaming-only skips.
- Installed affected runner/worker/consumer/Dataset suite: 222 passed, 3 skipped; existing bootstrap/family suite: 88 passed.
